data.description: Compara ambos listados y detecta cobros sin orden y órdenes sin cobro

config.expression: {"cobrosSinOrden": $filter(pagos, function($x) { $not($number($x.amount) in $map(ordenes, function($y){ $number($y.total) })) }), "ordenesSinCobro": $filter(ordenes, function($y) { $not($number($y.total) in $map(pagos, function($x){ $number($x.amount) })) })}

data.label: Anotar en Sheets

config.arguments: {"spreadsheet_id": "TU_SPREADSHEET_ID", "range": "Reconciliacion!A1", "values": [["{{@fecha-ayer:Fecha Ayer.desde}}", "Cobros sin orden", "{{@reconciliar:Reconciliar.result.cobrosSinOrden}}"], ["{{@fecha-ayer:Fecha Ayer.desde}}", "Ordenes sin cobro", "{{@reconciliar:Reconciliar.result.ordenesSinCobro}}"]]}
